Roles & Responsibilities
Working Hours & Calendar
Mondays to Fridays: 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM (inclusive of a 1-hour lunch break).
Rest Days: Service is strictly not required on Saturdays, Sundays, gazetted public holidays, and protected time during official school holidays.
Job Description & Key Responsibilities
We are seeking a pleasant, mature, and customer-oriented School Receptionist to run the front counter and handle vital administrative functions at Chung Cheng High School (Yishun). You will serve as the primary point of contact for the campus, providing excellent service to visitors, students, and staff.
1. Front Desk & Counter Management
Professional operations of the General Office reception counter, including answering all incoming telephone calls and routing queries efficiently.
Warmly greet and attend to walk-in parents, vendors, public visitors, and courier deliveries.
2. Student Welfare & Safety Support
Attend to students who visit the General Office counter, including managing administrative care for students who are sick or injured.
Coordinate parent notifications or early dismissal protocols according to standard school guidelines.
3. General Office Administration
Perform essential office administration tasks, including simple data entry, sorting, systematic filing, and document photocopying.
Provide administrative backup and handle any other operational matters as directed by school leaders.
Job Requirements
Education: Minimally completed a Secondary School Education.
Language Skills: Preferably bilingual; able to speak, read, and write effectively in both English and Mandarin to handle inquiries from a diverse group of visitors and parents.
Technical Literacy: Preferably skilled in using basic productivity software, specifically Microsoft Word and Excel.
Experience: Prior relevant working experience within a local school office environment or institutional front desk setting is highly preferred.
Personal Attributes: Possess a pleasant, warm, and mature disposition with strong active listening and interpersonal communication capabilities.

Sunnyhill Ace Pte Ltd is a Singapore-based company primarily engaged in general cleaning services, including the cleaning of offices, public areas, and factories
The company's services encompass standard office cleaning duties as detailed in its job descriptions for cleaner positions.
Typical services provided by the company include cleaning and sanitizing, dusting, vacuuming, sweeping, trash removal, restocking supplies, equipment maintenance, and ensuring safety compliance.
